patthana19.7:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca pitīsahagato dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā, cattāri.
patthana19.7:2.1: na sukhasahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sukhasahagato dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā, cattāri.
patthana19.7:3.1: na upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca upekkhāsahagato dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā, na upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca pitihagato dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā, cattāri,
